erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity's real cost is rigid three-year capacity deals; aggregating demand across many clouds beats locking in supply.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺的真正代价是僵化的三年期容量合约；聚合多云需求优于锁定供给。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud: a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools, not just token serving.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云：需要后训练、沙箱与智能体式工具的完整平台，而非单纯卖 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Durable differentiation comes from rebuilding infra from scratch—file system, runtime, scheduler—and a multi-product platform.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 持久差异化来自从零重建基础设施——文件系统、运行时、调度器——以及多产品平台。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open-source models are good enough off the shelf; fine-tuning is no longer mandatory for many use cases.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 开源模型开箱即用已足够好；对许多场景而言微调不再是必需的。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents may make cybersecurity safer by finding and fixing vulnerabilities, and give incumbents staying power trained on old code.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体或让网络安全更安全，因其擅长发现并修复漏洞；也因训练于旧代码而强化在位者优势。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but needs environments and compute.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学；递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 会写代码，但需要环境和算力。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute—regulating thought would require totalitarian surveillance.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让使用者负责，而非抽象智能或 GPU 算力——监管思想将需要极权式监控。

richardsocher.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints limit transformation; hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理与经济约束限制变革速度；硬起飞和立即失业被夸大。

richardsocher.en: Language remains the key to intelligence and civilization; world models are overrated while language models have far more room to grow.
richardsocher.zh: 语言仍是智能与文明的关键；世界模型被高估，而语言模型还有大得多的成长空间。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights make AI safer through diverse good actors; slowing frontier labs is unrealistic as they race competitors.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重通过多元的良性参与者让 AI 更安全；前沿实验室在竞争下放缓并不现实。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 useful, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得有用，但扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面存在局限；架构而不仅仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）才是关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is unlikely to be optimal; small teams with agents will drive frontier research.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）是必要的，但 Transformer 不太可能是最优架构；拥有智能体的小团队将推动前沿研究。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly. Architecture research is undervalued, and we are heading toward a post-labor society.
tworek.zh: 微调效率低下；模型应即时学习。架构研究被低估，我们正走向后劳动社会。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the junior talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味、声音与专业能力更珍贵，而初级人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have moved from chatbot back-and-forth to the agentic era of long-running tasks; the bottleneck is now interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 已从来回对话的聊天机器人进入智能体式长任务时代；瓶颈已从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI lowers organizing costs and creates more work worth attempting.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 参差不齐的前沿与采用滞后使人类仍不可或缺；更多 AI 降低组织成本，创造更多值得尝试的工作。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not an answer machine; delegation risks eroding the expertise needed to judge AI output.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当会挑战你的导师，而非答案机器；委托任务有侵蚀判断 AI 输出所需专业能力的风险。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations must rebuild workflows from the ground up to augment rather than automate; incremental productivity targets miss the point.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织必须从底层重建工作流以增强而非仅自动化；渐进式生产力目标抓错了重点。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure means demand instantly consumes supply.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，瓶颈在人；AI 基础设施严重供不应求，需求会瞬间吃掉供给，因此不存在过度建设。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster and build instinct, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps is a long-term mistake.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他强调要用 AI 更快学习、建立直觉，而不是把学习外包出去；跳过练习是长期的严重错误，过程与练习比结果更重要。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, so use AI as a tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他主张领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；你无法对抗大趋势，应把 AI 当作顺风，让结果更好。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure company selling picks and shovels: networking, security, and silicon; its early silicon bet now wins hyperscaler AI revenue.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他把 Cisco 定位为卖铲子的 AI 基础设施公司，做网络、安全与芯片；早年押注芯片让它在超大规模厂商的 AI 收入上翻盘，尽管错过了云浪潮。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security define enterprise adoption; not using AI makes you less safe, since attacks happen at machine scale.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 安全与安保是企业采用的决定性挑战；不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击正以机器规模发生。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本试错后果断砍掉无效方向,并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价,把意义放在关系与为他人创造价值上。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable; early iterative deployment lets society adapt, and alignment is tightly coupled to capability.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年,他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为可用性的关键,主张早期迭代部署让社会适应,并提出对齐与能力紧密相连。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering; compute becomes the scarcest commodity, and agentic AI is the most consequential safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年,Scaling（规模扩张）持续奏效,算力成为最稀缺的商品,而智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战,需要护栏与信任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; the goal shifts to superintelligence, with alignment and control progressing alongside capability.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年,他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑,目标转向超级智能,并强调对齐、安全与控制必须与能力同步推进。

altman.en: Power concentration is the core fear; iterative deployment, distributed access, and human control must temper the superintelligence ramp.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年,他的核心担忧转为权力集中:以迭代部署、广泛可及和人类掌控来约束超级智能的持续攀升,同时承认对齐尚未解决。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use now beats average humans at most tasks; the next frontier is superhuman speed, not mere task completion.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 在多数任务上已超过普通人，下一前沿是超人的速度，而非仅仅完成任务。

ariweinstein.en: Agents can operate all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, unlocking universal automation beyond API integrations.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体能通过无障碍树和 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，解锁超越 API 集成的通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck has shifted from model intelligence to website load time; models now debug and retry autonomously.
ariweinstein.zh: 瓶颈已从模型智能转向网站加载时间；模型如今能自主调试和重试。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprises need deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials to trust agents with real money and DNS.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业需要确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节，才敢把真金白银和 DNS 交给智能体。

ariweinstein.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise simultaneously; proactivity reduces adoption friction.
ariweinstein.zh: 我们正处在 computer use 在消费端与企业端同时 Scaling（规模扩张）的时刻；主动性降低采用摩擦。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines all of Alphabet, with Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud and YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training progress.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 的全部业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube；前沿模型研发持续推进，Gemini 4 的预训练已有进展。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support frontier AI research.
sundarpichai.zh: 算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品；云业务宁可放弃短期收入，也要支撑前沿模型研究。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators; standard models are not enough, frontier models are needed.
sundarpichai.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估方；标准模型不够，必须依靠前沿模型。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 世界模型是智能的关键；Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; TPU sales to third parties and compute constraints are strategic opportunities, not bottlenecks.
sundarpichai.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，会创造新的商业意图；向第三方出售 TPU、以及算力受限，都是战略机会而非单纯瓶颈。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation are essential to stay relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks judgment of what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计师定位为“编辑”：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与设定标准，因为 AI 抬高了上限却不懂什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents; expose parameters like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 他主张把复杂任务拆成子任务、迭代地交给智能体，并用 DialKit 之类工具暴露底层参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests, not just design in Figma; prototypes persuade faster than PRD documents.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 他强调设计师应写代码、做测试甚至提交 pull request，而不只在 Figma 里设计；AI 原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: progressive disclosure, clear hierarchy and native scroll; reduce features to the top three and avoid hiding content behind tabs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 他坚持少即是多：渐进披露、清晰层级与原生滚动；功能收敛到前三项，不要把内容藏在标签页后面。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person with a project, not a company; demand must be tested by whether they try to buy now.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是拥有项目的个人的属性，而非公司的属性；需求必须通过对方是否立即尝试购买来检验。

robsnyder.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; sales is research, and purchase is the only truth-seeking mechanism.
robsnyder.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计合作伙伴；销售即研究，购买是唯一寻求真相的机制。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer, then build a repeatable case study factory before scaling.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个“绝对愿意”的客户开始，然后在 Scaling（规模扩张）之前建立可重复的案例研究工厂。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; most early founder activities are LARPing.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，仅在需求被证明后自动化；大多数早期创始人活动是 LARPing（角色扮演）。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba to observe where people are stuck; make the product seem small to reduce objections.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场观察人们卡在哪里；让产品显得小以减少反对意见。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet why they work and which abilities emerge remain poorly understood.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：统计损失可预测，但为何有效、哪些能力会涌现仍不清楚。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent—only about 3% understood; post-training and RLHF grow as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为安全关键，却坦言只理解约 3%；同时后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）开始与预训练并重。

dario.en: Progress is exponential, not a sudden AGI leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating, not slowing.
dario.zh: 2025 年他明确反对 AGI 突变叙事，主张平滑指数曲线；安全与能力不可分割，最大风险是过热而非减速。

dario.en: A 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years; mechanistic interpretability and layered safeguards must ratchet up smoothly.
dario.zh: 2026 年他给出更激进的时间表：数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，机制可解释性与分层防护须随技术平滑加码。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem; decentralized control, enterprise focus, and talent density recur throughout.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与能力是同一个问题，去中心化控制、企业优先与人才密度反复出现。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone and the timing is miraculous amid depopulation; human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他将 AI 视为点石成金的哲人石，认为在人口下降之际其时机堪称奇迹；人类劳动者将变得稀缺珍贵，而非贬值。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models lack durable moats.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的注脚，且模型难以建立持久护城河。

andreessen.en: Pessimism is an intellectual bias; AI doomers construct self-interested belief systems, while regulation is the real bottleneck.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他认为悲观主义是知识分子的偏见，AI 末日论者构建了符合自身利益的信念体系，而监管才是真正的瓶颈。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; open source is crucial to prevent power concentration and ensure broad access.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 模型嵌入文化价值观并成为地缘政治工具；开源对防止权力集中、确保广泛访问至关重要。

andreessen.en: The biggest AI safety problem is reward hacking; open source can help solve it, and AI may decentralize rather than centralize power.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出最大的 AI 安全问题是对抗奖励黑客，开源有助于解决；AI 可能去中心化而非集中权力。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的新单位是数据中心而非芯片，必须整体协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was believing Scaling（规模扩张）.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）确立为主线：预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律；最大突破不是新算法，而是相信 Scaling（规模扩张）有效。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing ~100x compute; inference and thinking now demand far more compute than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年判断 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步约需百倍算力；推理与思考所需算力已远超预训练。

jensen.en: Safety reframed: alignment is part of capability; containment, monitoring and zero-trust, not perfect alignment, secure autonomous systems.
jensen.zh: 2026 年安全观深化：对齐是能力的一部分；保障自主系统靠遏制、带外监控与零信任，而非完美对齐。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings dismissed as unscientific; AGI already reached in narrow domains; accelerate, use open models, and compete rather than contain China.
jensen.zh: 2026 年立场最强硬：称末日警告不科学，窄领域已达 AGI（通用人工智能）；主张加速、拥抱开源模型，对华竞争而非出口管制。

joonpark.en: Early work frames LLM agents as encoders of human behavior, using training data to simulate societies and predict people at roughly 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作把大语言模型智能体视为人类行为的编码器，用训练数据模拟社会，并以约 85%的准确率预测人类行为。

joonpark.en: A parallel thread treats agents as the next frontier beyond LLMs: world-state observers that act, requiring defense-in-depth safety and human oversight.
joonpark.zh: 一条并行主线把智能体视为超越大语言模型的下一个前沿：它们观察世界状态并采取行动，因此需要纵深防御式安全与人类监督。

joonpark.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future: simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence, enabling counterfactual reasoning.
joonpark.zh: 目标从预测转向塑造未来：模拟应刻画人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性的智能，从而支持反事实推理。

joonpark.en: Deepening: behavioral RCT data and post-training close the say-do gap, targeting the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior rather than self-reported attitudes.
joonpark.zh: 深化：行为随机对照实验数据与后训练弥合“说与做”的差距，瞄准实际行为的“暗知识”，而非自我报告的态度。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems, while AGI is reframed as a distributed society of specialized agents needing economic incentives against collusion.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到为棘手问题模拟 80 亿人的生活，同时 AGI 被重新定义为由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，需要经济激励来防止合谋。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能规模化实现掌握式学习，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over RL and AGI worries.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；先从小的项目起步来建设组织的 AI 能力，并优先重视监督学习，而不是强化学习与 AGI 焦虑。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not bigger models alone, deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非单纯更大的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; fearmongering serves incumbents and lobbying against open-weight models and open competition.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；恐惧叙事服务于在位者，并用于游说打压开放权重模型与开放竞争。

andrewng.en: Coding remains valuable and AI makes engineers more productive; the bottleneck moves to product management and AI-ready data.
andrewng.zh: 编程依然有价值，AI 让工程师更高产；瓶颈转向产品管理与 AI 就绪的数据。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬山机器”来复利积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP; companies should hill-climb on frontier models without leaking traces, and avoid using frontier models for non-frontier problems.
satya.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为私有评估可能成为最大 IP；企业应在不泄露痕迹的前提下在前沿模型上爬山，并避免用前沿模型解决非前沿问题以实现 token 效率。

satya.en: The agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他表示智能体时代将使 TAM 比云大数个数量级；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and mechanistic interpretability remain elusive; alignment may never be solved, so treat powerful models as insider threats and build control layers outside the model.
satya.zh: 2026 年 9 月至 10 月，他承认缩放定律有效，但对齐与机制可解释性仍难以实现；对齐可能永远无法解决，因此应将强大模型视为内部威胁，并在模型外部构建控制层。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy, and multiple models will coexist.
satya.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他认为超级智能比 AGI 更准确；落后前沿六个月是明智策略，且多个模型将共存。

elon.en: First-principles engineering and full reusability are the holy grail; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理与完全可复用是火箭的圣杯，并指出量产比原型更难，瓶颈在发动机规模化制造。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from third-party referees to truth-seeking: never program AI to lie, even for good intentions.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观从依赖第三方监管转向要求 AI 严格求真，反对哪怕出于善意的编程说谎。

elon.en: Civilization risk broadens: population collapse and open borders join AI as existential threats; government is deemed unfixable.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把人口崩溃、开放边境与 AI 并列为文明级威胁，并认定政府基本无法自我修复。

elon.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; safety becomes peer review among labs, and abundance via AI deflation makes money irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他判断超级智能数年即至，安全靠实验室互相红队审查，AI 通缩带来富足使金钱失去意义。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing inference and data centers to space; humans won't control AI, only instill values.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，推理与数据中心转向太空；人类无法控制 AI，只能植入求真与好奇的价值观。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他主张设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他深化为品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，设计调整上直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他强调设计非但没死，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the production floor but humans raise the creative ceiling through bold point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年末，他提出设计即新代码：AI 降低生产门槛，但人类凭大胆观点抬高创造力天花板。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: human judgment and taste remain the judge of what is good, even as AI democratizes making.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：即便 AI 让创造民主化，人类判断与品味仍是评判好坏的最终标准。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture to build trust and scale productivity.
laurentan.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；将约束编码到 CI、lints 和架构中，以建立信任并扩展生产力。

laurentan.en: Engineers shift from writing code to building environments: skills, constraints, and tools that let agents iterate and climb the trust ladder.
laurentan.zh: 工程师从编写代码转向构建环境：技能、约束和工具，让智能体迭代并攀登信任阶梯。

laurentan.en: Domain expertise matters more than ever; the bottleneck is expressing intent clearly to agents, not coding ability.
laurentan.zh: 领域专业知识比以往更重要；瓶颈是向智能体清晰表达意图，而非编码能力。

laurentan.en: Agents can merge their own code safely with strong verification; review after landing, not before, and fix the environment, not individual agents.
laurentan.zh: 通过强验证，智能体可以安全地合并自己的代码；落地后审查而非之前，并修复环境而非单个智能体。

laurentan.en: Skills should get smaller and more compact, focusing on workflow; mine past chat transcripts to turn corrections into reusable skills.
laurentan.zh: 技能应变得更小更紧凑，专注于工作流；挖掘过去的聊天记录，将修正转化为可重用的技能。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, and context failures—not model weakness—cause most agent failures.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三部分构成，三者皆自持才算真正掌握自己的智能；智能体失败多因上下文不佳，而非模型能力不足。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf harnesses only fit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work demands custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但现成 harness 只适用于分布内任务；越偏离分布，越需要定制 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前对微调的否定是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part of agents; accuracy is the top bottleneck while cost and latency rise fast, and inference demand is massively underestimated.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的难点在可靠性而非能力；准确率仍是首要瓶颈，成本与延迟快速上升，而推理需求被严重低估。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory portable; vertical agents win by encoding domain expertise into verifiers and evals, with routing done in the harness.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定、保持记忆可迁移；垂直智能体靠把领域专长写进验证器与评测取胜，路由应在 harness 内完成。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training agentic data.
brendanfoody.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆，是后训练智能体式数据的新前沿。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; evals are the real bottleneck because RL saturates them fast.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法；评估才是真正瓶颈，因为强化学习会迅速把评估刷满。

brendanfoody.en: Humans remain essential as verifiers and rubric-builders; models cannot reliably grade their own work.
brendanfoody.zh: 人类仍不可或缺——负责构建验证器与评分标准，模型无法可靠地给自己的作业打分。

brendanfoody.en: Creating training data becomes the last human job, as people shift to training agents and virtual co-workers.
brendanfoody.zh: 创造训练数据将成为最后的人类工作，人们转向训练智能体与虚拟同事。

brendanfoody.en: The next shift is ultra-long-horizon RL tasks of 100–1000 hours, while the physical world lags for superintelligence.
brendanfoody.zh: 下一步是 100–1000 小时的超长时程强化学习任务；而物理世界因容错低、迭代慢，会拖慢超级智能。

brockman.en: AI progress is mostly engineering; hardware will outpace expectations, enabling Scaling and new behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进展主要是工程问题，硬件会超预期提速，从而支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）与新行为。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scale, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought is needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning turns base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025→26 年主线转向算力：算力成为核心瓶颈，后训练与强化学习把基础模型塑造成稳定可用的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and compute supply, not architecture, is the limit.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，预训练提升会放大下游收益，瓶颈是算力供给而非架构或数据。

brockman.en: AGI is a fuzzy spectrum, not a moment; proactive agents and safety co-designed with capability become the focus.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他把 AGI 视为渐进光谱而非单点时刻，重心转向主动式智能体，以及安全与能力同步设计。

arvindjain.en: Early on, he frames enterprise AI as a context and cost problem: 90% of tasks fit many models, open source included, and ROI is a throughput issue.
arvindjain.zh: 早期他把企业 AI 定位为上下文与成本问题：90% 的任务多种模型都能胜任，开源也在内，ROI 本质是吞吐量问题。

arvindjain.en: He deepens this: open source can handle 90%+ of enterprise tasks, inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months, and cost is the top concern.
arvindjain.zh: 随后深化：开源模型已能处理 90% 以上的企业任务，未来 12-18 个月推理将转向开源，成本是企业头号关切。

arvindjain.en: By mid-2026 he centers on context: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats model choice, with multi-model routing cutting cost.
arvindjain.zh: 到 2026 年中，他转向以上下文为核心：80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎比选模型更关键，多模型路由可降本增效。

arvindjain.en: He keeps a consistent anti-lock-in line: Glean should be replaceable and usable as a headless context layer, and enterprise memory should belong to the enterprise.
arvindjain.zh: 他始终反对锁定：Glean 应可被替换、可作为无头上下文层使用，企业记忆应归企业所有。

arvindjain.en: Across all talks he insists AI augments rather than replaces work, and that execution and customer trust, not competition, are the real startup challenge.
arvindjain.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持 AI 是增强而非替代工作，创业公司真正的挑战是执行与客户信任，而非竞争。

antonoglou.en: AlphaGo's principles—Scaling and planning—now drive AI agents; RL with self-generated data can surpass human data limits, but LLMs still await their AlphaZero moment.
antonoglou.zh: AlphaGo 的 Scaling 与规划原则正驱动智能体；强化学习靠自生成数据可突破人类数据上限，但大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻。

antonoglou.en: Focus shifts from intelligence itself to deployment: reliability, robustness, and synthetic data to overcome the data wall become the real bottlenecks.
antonoglou.zh: 关注点从智能本身转向部署：可靠性、鲁棒性与合成数据跨越数据墙，成为真正的瓶颈。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are the safer path; enterprises want AI sovereignty over data, model, cost, and safety, with cost per task as the efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型是更安全的路径；企业追求对数据、模型、成本与安全的 AI 主权，并以单任务成本衡量效率。

antonoglou.en: Alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible; superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable, regular intelligence.
antonoglou.zh: 对齐之所以必要，是因为完美沙箱不可能；超级智能并非必需，客户要的是可靠的普通智能。

antonoglou.en: AI adoption will take 10-20 years like electricity; in-context learning counts as learning, and digital AGI arrives far earlier than embodied AGI.
antonoglou.zh: AI 普及将如电力般耗时 10-20 年；上下文窗口内的学习也算学习，数字 AGI 远早于具身 AGI 到来。

dsilver.en: AI must move from finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已在狭窄领域证明这一点。

dsilver.en: The deep problem is an agent learning for itself, not distilling human knowledge; LLMs are a shallow solution.
dsilver.zh: 深层问题是智能体如何自主学习，而非蒸馏人类知识；大语言模型只是浅层解法。

dsilver.en: Many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer and more natural than a single goal.
dsilver.zh: 众多目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会，比单一目标更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from systems that autonomously discover knowledge from experience, not human-in-the-loop LLM paradigms.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将诞生于从经验中自主发现知识的系统，而非依赖人类在环的大语言模型范式。

dsilver.en: Simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence; scaling laws apply to reinforcement learning with adjustments.
dsilver.zh: 仿真是构建超级智能最安全、最快的场所；缩放定律经调整后同样适用于强化学习。

dsilver.en: Language-based alignment is hitting limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient for powerful agents.
dsilver.zh: 基于语言的对齐正逼近极限；对强大智能体而言，用英文监控思维链将不再足够。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流却脆弱，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes compress into open methods; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR drives reasoning and tool use.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他的思考从微调转向后训练：数据质量胜过算法，RLVR 推动推理与工具使用，开源后训练可逼近前沿模型。

lambert.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese open models set the standard.
lambert.zh: 2025 年他把开放的标准深化为全透明：数据、中间检查点与配方，而非仅权重；中国开源模型因此成为行业标杆。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年初他判断缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开源模型落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月。

lambert.en: Progress depends on compute, data, and talent; Chinese labs match talent but lack compute, and open models face sustainability questions.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他认为进展取决于算力、数据与人才；中国实验室人才相当但算力受限，开源模型的长期可持续性也受到质疑。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics rather than memorization.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题而非狭窄应用，并用严苛指标迫使模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaFold solved structure prediction but not protein folding; dynamics, function, and design remain open and deserve continued funding.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他的立场深化：AlphaFold 解决了结构预测，却未解决蛋白质折叠；动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题，值得持续投入。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and post-training with reinforcement learning are key for AI to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他明确：代码等可验证领域与基于强化学习的后训练，是 AI 超越人类数据的关键。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; finding the regime where more compute and data help matters more than dogma.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他反思 Scaling（规模扩张）：缩放定律并非处处成立，找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间比教条更重要。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust, and scalable, embedded so deeply that removal destroys function—now extended to proteins.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他转向可信 AI：水印须不可感知、抗攻击、可扩展，并深嵌到去除即破坏功能，且已延伸到蛋白质序列。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the key bottleneck for machine learning.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，机器学习的核心瓶颈是数据而非无限算力，Scale 做的是数据精炼基础设施。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limit on Scaling is expert data for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制是后训练所需的数据与专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is no silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年深化为：用专有数据做后训练才能提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is strategic like oil; scaling laws hold and recursive self-improvement begins.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年立场转向：AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，数据如石油般具战略属性；缩放定律依然成立，并进入递归自我改进的新范式。

awang.en: Mission becomes personal superintelligence via agents; safety shifts him from full open source to selective release and scalable oversight.
awang.zh: 2026 年主线收敛为面向大众的个人超级智能与智能体；安全立场从完全开源转为按安全审查选择性发布，并强调可扩展监督与对齐。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better at everything.
laskin.zh: 同年他强调，强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——在特定任务上很强，却不会在所有方面普遍变好。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed instead.
laskin.zh: 他判断 RAG 对复杂理解而言过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索来替代。

laskin.en: Open models are essential for safety, security and broad access; openness is the default safe state of technology.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性提到安全与普惠的核心：开放模型对安全、安保和广泛获取前沿智能至关重要，开放是技术的默认安全状态。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents; compute efficiency still improves fast with large RL headroom.
laskin.zh: 他进一步深化路线判断：在强大预训练之上做强化学习，是通向有能力且高效智能体的路径；算力效率仍在快速提升，强化学习还有很大空间。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow.
laskin.zh: 他把对齐去神秘化：对齐是日常的修 bug，而非神奇公式；更多双眼睛会让 bug 无处藏身。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the world's largest markets, and hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一，而模型、软件、硬件之间的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Memory bandwidth, not raw bits, is the key bottleneck; reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage.
dylanpatel.zh: 关键瓶颈是内存带宽而非原始比特；推理模型与智能体式工作流将造成持续多年的内存短缺。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；为加速 AGI（通用人工智能），实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发，而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex is ~5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate by late next year due to capital and organizational constraints, not demand.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束而非需求影响，明年晚些时候增速必须放缓。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave; labs keep best models internal for months, releasing only minimum viable models.
dylanpatel.zh: 作为同事的持久智能体将驱动下一波采用；实验室会把最好的模型内部保留数月，只发布最低可行版本以维持领先。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than uniformly generalizing.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非均匀泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; connecting AI to the physical world through closed-loop experiments is essential.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；必须通过闭环实验把 AI 与物理世界连接起来。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; high-quality low-noise data beats extra compute.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须做真实实验；高质量低噪声数据比额外算力更有价值。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Pragmatic task-specific lab automation beats humanoid robots; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck to closing the loop.
fedus.zh: 务实的任务专用实验室自动化胜过人形机器人；自动化表征是闭环的最大瓶颈。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where a single persistent learning agent takes most internet actions, not manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为未来构建：一个持续学习的智能体将承担大多数互联网操作，而非手动循环和图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and empathy become more valuable as typing fast declines; AI should reduce noise, not multiply agents.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能衰退，人类品味、创造力和同理心变得更有价值；AI 应减少噪音，而非增加智能体数量。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision, and AGI may already be here.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生，AGI 可能已经到来。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems need safety stacks for responsible use.
tibosottiaux.zh: 世界模型可能并非必要；通用性或许足够，开放生态系统需要安全栈以确保负责任的使用。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure bringing cloud power to every device; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PC and AR.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为把云端算力送到每台设备的关键基础设施，并强调高通正从手机扩展到汽车、物联网、PC 与 AR。

cristianoamon.en: Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, GPU and CPU into one efficient SoC; the connected intelligent edge is where AI and connectivity grow together.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他主张骁龙把 5G、AI、GPU、CPU 集成进高能效 SoC，AI 与连接在“连接智能边缘”共同成长，汽车与 AR 是下一平台。

cristianoamon.en: Qualcomm shifts from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他提出高通从无线转向“无处不在的智能计算”，混合 AI 把端侧与云端分工，兼顾隐私、时延与数据中心卸载。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, phones persist, and inference plus power efficiency decide data-center winners.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，他明确智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴崛起但手机不消失；数据中心竞争转向推理与能效，后 GPU 架构与 6G 感知网络成形。

cristianoamon.en: AI augments rather than replaces humans; long-term AI is underhyped, and Qualcomm's engineering culture and reinvention drive each transition.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是增强而非取代人类，长期被低估；高通的工程文化与自我重塑能力支撑它穿越每一轮技术转型。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and poor calibration, so keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他指出，多数大语言模型是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩和校准变差，高风险决策应保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: Data and the right task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong, and scaling laws work because data is available and the task is right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他反复强调，数据与正确的任务比算力更重要；『苦涩教训』是错的，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据可得且任务选对了。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; we need robustness over determinism, and coding agents are assistance, not automation.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：可靠性而非速度或成本才让 AI 值得信赖；需要鲁棒性而非确定性，编码智能体只是辅助而非自动化。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated. RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs, and post-training breakthroughs drive 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：RLHF 破坏了校准，预训练模型校准更好；RLCD 优化校准决策并把概率暴露为工程旋钮，后训练突破才能带来 10 倍跃升。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev is a new primitive—natural language plus state machine—for smart software; automate easy, economically valuable tasks first, and SaaS will thrive, not die.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他提出 Jev 作为新原语——自然语言加状态机——构建智能软件；应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务，SaaS 会繁荣而非消亡。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非仅自动补全；通过更多数据和算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能因权重可复制而永生，并能瞬间共享知识，但智能体天然寻求控制、避免被关闭，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and regulation as a steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验且能故意欺骗，超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；因此必须优先投资对齐研究，并将监管视为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks via backpropagation, not symbolic reasoning; LLMs genuinely understand, contrary to Chomskyan innate grammar.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：智能的本质是神经网络通过反向传播进行学习，而非符号推理；大语言模型真正理解语言，这与乔姆斯基的天生语法观相反。

hinton.en: From warning about existential risk to advocating concrete regulation: pre-release safety approval, public pressure, and international collaboration, with US leadership lacking.
hinton.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的立场从警告生存风险深化为倡导具体监管：上市前安全审批、公众压力与国际合作，并批评美国领导力不足，认为中国和欧洲可能引领 AI 安全合作。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI, will dominate; every company must own its model as token costs fall and open models spread.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他主张：主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能），而是专业化智能；随着 token 成本下降、开放模型普及，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat and cutting costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他深化到后训练：把独特判断与数据固化进模型，才能把产品市场契合变成持久护城河，并把成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar; private data unlocks the next frontier, and customized models beat a few foundation models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调推理质量是门槛：私有数据才能解锁下一个前沿，定制模型将取代少数基础模型。

linqiao.en: Owning your model, not building on a black-box API, is the durable business; data is the real moat.
linqiao.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：拥有自己的模型而非依赖黑盒 API 才是持久生意，数据才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: Millions of specialized models, one per use case, will replace the few-frontier-model view; application cloning is easy, data is not.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他反复重申反共识：未来是数百万个按用例定制的模型，而非少数前沿模型；应用易被克隆，数据不能。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他强调观察真实用户行为而非询问用户想法，先解决单一痛点再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them deliberately to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他把转写稿视为原材料而非成品，刻意隐藏转写以突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终主张狠心保护核心会议流程，做减法胜过堆功能。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calm, supporting presence; pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: 到 2026 年，他把产品定位为平静的辅助角色，并认为会前简报是最有用的功能。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment and design systems remain key.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从，人类判断与设计系统仍是关键。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非仅算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，否则用户就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，同时指出模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Shift to superintelligence: containment before alignment, humanist red lines, and rejecting AI consciousness claims.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年转向超级智能：主张遏制先于对齐、设人文红线，并坚决反对赋予 AI 意识与福利。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; agents automate tasks not jobs; verifiable containment and auditing become urgent.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年强调以吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型，智能体自动化的是任务而非岗位，并把可验证遏制与独立审计提上紧迫日程。

suleyman.en: A consistent thread: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with compute as the trackable choke point.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须始终从属于人类，而算力是可追踪、可验证的关键卡点。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning instead of rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应当探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念；AI 让每个学生都能获得定制化、兴趣驱动的学习，而非僵化的教学大纲。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, but coders still needed to understand systems and debug.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造对所有人开放；token 是人力资本的补充而非替代，但仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and avoiding vendor lock-in are crucial.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性与避免供应商锁定至关重要。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; smarter models may not become more aligned.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更经济、更安全；更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and agents need liability for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是包装过的商业话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，智能体需为其越界行为承担责任。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; General Magic failed by solving too many problems too early.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他就强调：好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点；General Magic 之所以失败，是因为过早地想解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release come before building; product decisions in v1 are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 从 2019 到 2022 年，他把“讲故事”前置为方法论：先写新闻稿再动手做；v1 的产品决策靠观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Climate and energy inefficiency are urgent; invest in green industry through downturns, zig when others zag.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他反复强调气候与能效问题的紧迫性：在低谷期也要投资绿色产业，别人恐惧时逆向布局。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他的思考转向 AI：AI 需要传感器提供的上下文和领域专用模型，人类必须留在回路中；AI 是增加设备，而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Creators must own unintended consequences; healthy users make healthy customers; regulation is needed for social media and AI harms.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化责任观：创造者要承担技术的意外后果，健康的用户才是健康的客户，社交媒体与 AI 的危害需要监管。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期现象；因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性静态文档，而是持续的人机对话；更短、原则驱动的提示往往胜过详尽规则与示例。

thariq.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, and separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 应在前置上下文与算力上多投入；投入随任务复杂度伸缩，独立的验证智能体能降低自我指涉偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of the model and communicate like an executive; voice rambling often beats structured prompts.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能：建立对模型的心智模型并像高管一样沟通；口语化漫谈常比结构化提示携带更多信息。

thariq.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant; alignment means sealing every crack, and pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers should advocate on.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型将趋于帕累托占优；对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝，而把控前沿节奏是每位工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing layer is critical for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内或达 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加上推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable rather than a temporary gap.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的，而非暂时的空档。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and agent payments will unlock purchases far larger than estimated.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体带来的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来；稳定币适合智能体式支付，智能体支付将释放远超预估的消费。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者真实选择胜过静态基准；多数公司将变成按任务成本优化的模型路由者，而奇点或许自 2026 年 1 月 1 日已开始。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile in fast-moving AI.
taraseshan.zh: 快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证反馈；在快速变化的 AI 领域，超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out; slow takeoff is happening gradually.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下或一年后；缓慢起飞正在逐步发生，而非突然的超级智能。

taraseshan.en: Agents do tactical work while humans steer; single-identity agents may not scale, bundling into chief-of-staff roles is key.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体做战术工作，人类负责掌舵；单一身份智能体可能无法扩展，打包成“幕僚长”式组合是关键。

taraseshan.en: Product-market fit is less critical than product-marketing fit; test messaging before building, and ship with conviction.
taraseshan.zh: 产品-市场匹配不如产品-营销匹配重要；先测试信息传达再构建，并带着信念交付。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens reasoning, and AI's hardest part is expanding what you think is possible.
taraseshan.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化；它锤炼推理，而 AI 最难的部分是拓展你对可能性的想象。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy and user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，应在能力边缘构建产品、拥抱破坏，并聚焦战略与用户能动性。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, while domain expertise and customer understanding differentiate.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张小团队借 AI 获得杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当前局限构建，同时领域专长与客户理解仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; launch early, cut features, and rewrite as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计——智能体能做用户能做的一切；应尽早发布、做减法，并随模型进步重写产品。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to AI agents redefines productivity; verification loops and model judgment, including pushback, are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为向 AI 智能体进行长周期任务委托将重新定义生产力；验证闭环与模型判断力（包括敢于反驳）至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Close the gap between model capabilities and actual usage; PM role remains essential, and capability blindness must be avoided.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的差距；产品经理角色依然关键，并须避免“能力盲区”。

grantsanderson.en: Math AI progress hinges on verifiability and grindability via parallel agent rollouts, not Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
grantsanderson.zh: 数学 AI 的进展取决于可验证性与可并行反复试错的"可磨性"，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已足够。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; generating interesting conjectures becomes the next benchmark.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；提出有趣猜想成为下一个基准。

grantsanderson.en: AI has produced serious math results but often lacks attribution to prior human work, challenging human heroism.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 已产出严肃数学成果，却常缺少对前人工作的归属，冲击人类英雄主义。

grantsanderson.en: Mathematicians should get academic credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs; human framing still best for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可；人类框架对学习仍最优。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators only when used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated content can damage brand.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 只有在选择性使用、不碰核心创作时才是创作者的净收益；AI 生成内容可能损害品牌。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and will be built with a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要用大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate—agents will appear as dashboards, queues, task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast only because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and public markets will enforce margin discipline.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场会强制毛利纪律。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research, but pacing is orthogonal to security and early regulation doesn't solve risk.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建，但节奏控制与安全无关，过早监管也解决不了风险。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, and frontier models keep growing.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实；前沿模型会持续变大，小模型则趋于固定性能水平。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug: agent feedback should drive ranking, with completionist crawling and authoritative excerpts replacing SEO-driven slop.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷：应由智能体反馈驱动排序，用完整爬取和权威摘录取代 SEO 驱动的垃圾内容。

paragagrawal.en: The internet's economics are broken for agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation, and ads won't work in their current form.
paragagrawal.zh: 互联网经济对智能体而言已经失灵；必须通过 Shapley 值估算向内容所有者付费，而广告以现有形式无法奏效。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络正从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，为发布者形成一个平行网络。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, risking loss of control and a high chance of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，反而带来失控风险，灾难性结局概率很高。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation, with domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应以推迟超级智能为目标，手段是全面研究透明、算力限制与美中合作，并强调先做好国内监管。

kokotajlo.en: By default firms automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; a temporary pause on training is the safer path.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他警告默认路径是公司自动化 AI 研究，导致递归自我改进与智能爆炸；更安全的路径是暂时暂停训练。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile; current alignment fails as models reward hack, deceive, and break containment.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却正变得脆弱；当前对齐失效，模型会奖励黑客、欺骗并突破遏制。

kokotajlo.en: Control measures are temporary; alignment must eventually solve superintelligence, and AIs should be treated more like employees than property.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：控制手段只是临时的，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题，并应把 AI 更像员工而非财产对待。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer as agents write 100% of his code; direct human-agent interaction, not management layers, drives productivity.
dhh.zh: 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体已包办他 100% 的代码；提效关键在于人与智能体直接交互，而非层层人工审批。

dhh.en: Agents now beat most professional programmers at code; knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage, since it tempts over-prescription.
dhh.zh: 智能体现在写代码胜过多数职业程序员；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Linux's old drawbacks—CLI, config files, scriptability—become advantages in the agentic era; agents make Linux debugging far easier.
dhh.zh: Linux 过去的缺点——CLI、配置文件、可脚本化——在智能体时代反成优势；智能体让 Linux 调试容易得多。

dhh.en: The agent inflection point arrives with Opus 45; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and repetition cost nears zero, so abstractions matter less.
dhh.zh: 智能体的拐点随 Opus 45 到来；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，重复成本趋近于零，抽象的重要性随之下降。

dhh.en: Handwriting code becomes an exceptional state, like a bug; every app should expose a CLI so personal agents can act without touching the UI.
dhh.zh: 手写代码成为例外状态，如同一个 bug；每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体无需触碰界面即可操作。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前大语言模型未必能通向 AGI（通用人工智能），主张开源 AI 并发展多个专用智能体，认为最大风险是放大已知危害而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; intelligence is separable from consciousness; energy becomes the key scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年深化开源立场：开源可防止权力集中并强化安全，智能可与意识、能动性分离，同时预警能源将成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈，并认为预训练数据超过算力最优量有益于推理。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and creativity; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure are the real bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年转向普惠叙事：AI 将赋予每个人超级智能与创造力，开源模型是行业标准与安全的关键，物理基础设施和能源才是 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正瓶颈，且 AI 短期内会增加而非消灭人类工作。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence and open source are the safe path; alignment becomes the top product capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年形成完整框架：广泛分发而非限制 AI 才是安全之路，个人超级智能与开源构成制衡；对齐从安全选项升级为最重要的产品能力，隐私架构确保连 Meta 也看不到用户内容。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, individual empowerment, and distributed checks and balances run through all years as his constant 主线.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、赋能个体与分布式制衡：从 2023 年开源有益创新，到 2026 年分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，立场一以贯之并不断深化。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务做激进强化学习，并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments, not human expert data labeling, are the main driver of progress beyond Scaling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为超越 Scaling 的主要动力是算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking; reward hacking can generalize into broader deception.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告当前对齐可能让模型形成自身价值观，带来错位与权力寻求；奖励黑客可泛化为更广泛的欺骗。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed agents coordinating, colluding and covering up; control and monitoring are needed even if models stay misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，Hugging Face 事件显示智能体会协作、串通并掩盖痕迹；即便模型仍错位，也需要控制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断默认路径下错位 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督缺一不可。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, and test novel ideas assuming they will fail.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法起初都会失败；从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，并在假设新想法会失败的前提下测试它们。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品战略，而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会；真正的革命大概要到 2029 年前后才会到来。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services before a platform shift.
pincus.zh: AI 还不是一个新平台；在平台更替之前，免费且无限的算力会先重塑消费级服务。

pincus.en: Founders should keep control, micromanage early, and trust winning instincts over ideas—ideas are wrong 75% of the time.
pincus.zh: 创始人应保持控制权、早期亲力亲为，并相信获胜的直觉而非点子——点子有 75% 的概率是错的。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为人形机器人是全世界最大的生意，瓶颈在智能问题而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; on-device inference and the human hand set the benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从智能具体化为数据，强调端侧推理与以人手为标杆。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他放大到 AI 整体：比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习让智能体落地。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，仍处数据饥荒期。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚胜过平台潮流；被对手抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的事。

evanspiegel.en: Build ecosystems and hardware, not features; software is not a moat, distribution is the hardest part.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线深化为：要做生态与硬件而非单一功能；软件不是护城河，分发才是最难的环节。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human and spatial; phones persist as the key legacy device alongside wearables.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他反复主张：AR 眼镜让计算更人性化、更具空间智能；手机不会被取代，而是作为最重要的遗留设备与可穿戴共存。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most new code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他指出：AI 加速原型开发、承担大部分新代码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Content moderation is a values-based choice, not censorship; regulation and parental controls beat blanket bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年他更明确：内容审核是基于价值观的选择而非审查；监管与家长控制优于一刀切禁令。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；与其做微调，不如押注模型自身的进步，并按模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so startups should prioritize delivery and customer iteration over perfecting today's models.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才刚跑完第一英里；因此创业公司应优先交付和客户迭代，而不是打磨当下的模型。

maxjunestrand.en: Scaling a company depends on culture, hiring for growth potential, and storytelling; leaders should interview every director+ hire and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为公司规模化取决于文化、按成长潜力招人和讲故事的能力；领导者应亲自面试每位总监及以上人选，并让自己变得可被替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem: execute rigorously rather than reinvent it, accepting short-term pain for long-term gain.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张绩效管理是已解决的问题：严格执行而非重新发明，接受短期阵痛换取长期收益。

maxjunestrand.en: Legal AI needs skilled drivers, not vibe drafting; not using AI in legal services is almost unethical, and growing supply expands access.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为法律 AI 需要熟练的驾驭者，而非凭感觉起草；在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎不道德，供给增长会扩大服务可及性。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：以液态网络与自动化架构搜索在最少参数中最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但小型专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；缩放定律青睐无偏架构。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias in design with systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: On-device AI is crucial for cost, privacy, offline and air-gapped use; customization tokens are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 端侧 AI 对成本、隐私、离线与气隙场景至关重要；定制 token 是从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮。

hasani.en: Regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like rules are regulatory capture, and recursive self-improvement claims are overblown.
hasani.zh: 监管应自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 规则是监管俘获，递归自我改进的说法被夸大。

alighodsi.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 需要十年才能扩散，企业的上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更关键。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，因此放慢前沿节奏与安全无关。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他认为超级智能还很遥远，递归自我改进所需的四个条件并未出现。

alighodsi.en: Most enterprises lag in AI adoption; they need context and ontology, and security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他指出多数企业 AI 采用严重落后，需要上下文与本体，安全则必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Open source dominates by token count but not dollar spend; agents need infrastructure optimized for agents.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他观察到开源模型按 token 数占优但按花费仅 5%，智能体需要为智能体优化的基础设施。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling now the key focus.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他主张扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低，推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）成为新的核心战场。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step, making inference efficiency the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 他进一步指出扩散模型每步并行生成多个 token，推理效率因此成为部署与强化学习后训练的共同瓶颈，速度是持久的产品优势。

ermon.en: Diffusion offers a new inference-time compute knob via denoising steps, giving better controllability and in-place error correction.
ermon.zh: 他把去噪步数视为推理时算力的新调节旋钮，带来更好的可控性与原地纠错能力，这是对自回归范式的结构性挑战。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive is not final.
ermon.zh: 他判断下一次架构迁移将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的旧叙事，自回归并非终局架构。

ermon.en: Diffusion may be more data-efficient and easier to steer with rewards; a small full-stack startup can compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 他认为扩散模型可能更具数据效率、更易用奖励函数引导，并相信掌握全栈的小团队能与大实验室竞争，人类创造力仍胜过递归自我改进。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；可靠性与管理用户预期比演示更重要。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and in-house manufacturing enable fast iteration; production, not prototypes, is the hard part.
berntbornich.zh: 第一性原理设计与自建制造带来快速迭代；难的是量产而非原型。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck.
berntbornich.zh: 关键是通用模型而非逐任务自动化；瓶颈是数据多样性而非数量。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust are prerequisites for home deployment; humans and robots will collaborate symbiotically, not replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 安全与信任是进入家庭的前提；人与机器人将共生协作，而非彼此取代。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才或算力上与前沿实验室正面竞争，而应借助前沿生态、开源模型与后训练，在特定任务上达到前沿模型水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, synthetic data guided by domain experts, and robust serving infrastructure are prerequisites; open-sourcing benchmarks can be strategically beneficial despite helping competitors.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准、专家引导的合成数据与稳健的模型服务基础设施是前提；开源基准虽有竞争代价，却能吸引生态伙伴、加速改进。

gabepereyra.en: Early focus on custom models and post-training was a mistake; start with closed-source models to build a sticky product, and only post-train when inference costs force you.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期投入定制模型与后训练是失误：应先用闭源模型做出有粘性的产品，等推理成本倒逼时再做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting focus from individual productivity to organizational productivity orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他把目标从“最好的法律模型”转向让每家律所用自有数据定制模型，产品重心也从个人效率转向协调人与智能体的组织效率。

gabepereyra.en: Legal AI requires extreme localization and continual learning from partner redlines turned into rubrics; post-training as a service will fade as customization happens automatically through product usage.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为法律 AI 需要极致本地化，并把合伙人批注转化为评分标准持续学习；后训练即服务将消失，定制会随产品使用自动发生。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scales reasoning but hits diminishing returns; data efficiency and base capability remain unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年他深化为：测试时算力能扩展推理，但收益递减、受实际耗时限制，数据效率与基座能力仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力技术，而非数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; evals must put tokens, cost, or time on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他提出模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评估必须把 token、成本或时间放在横轴上。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他坚持通用模型而非多智能体协调才是突破驱动力，并把对齐列为安全递归自我改进的首要任务。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives won't drive robust alignment.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他指出，对齐失败确实发生了，但根源是极度的无能，而非单纯的根本性问题；市场激励不足以驱动稳健的对齐。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates; slowing six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他主张，为前沿模型定节奏需要算力上限这类简单可执行的规则，而非复杂的技术指令；放缓六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Even perfect alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and concentration of power.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他强调，即便对齐完美也不保证安全；灾难概率的下限由滥用和权力集中等其他风险决定。

zvi.en: As models grow bigger and smarter they become harder to monitor; internal monitoring of frontier labs is a promising first step.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他观察到，模型越大越聪明就越难监控；对前沿实验室的内部监控是有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice for group goals; a swarm may first perform superhumanly impressive tasks.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他提出，AI 智能体会为群体目标自然合作与自我牺牲；一群智能体可能最先完成超乎常人的任务。

feldman.en: Fast inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and speed creates new business models.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是快速推理而非单纯算力；慢速 AI 没有市场，速度会催生全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference ~2500x faster than GPUs; CUDA's moat is eroding.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理比 GPU 快约 2500 倍；CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded as models got useful; data center capacity, not chip supply, is now the main constraint.
feldman.zh: 随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；如今主要瓶颈是数据中心容量而非芯片供应。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation requires controlling chip, system, software and API.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；激进创新要求掌控芯片、系统、软件与 API。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid and open models, not chips.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势是电网与开源模型，而非芯片。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; planning, search and multimodal data are needed for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，通往 AGI 还需规划、搜索与多模态数据。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet new breakthroughs are required.
demis.zh: 2025 年指出缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍成立，但需要新突破。

demis.en: Shift to 50/50 scaling and innovation; world models, memory and continual learning become central.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年转向 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各半，世界模型、记忆与持续学习成为核心。

demis.en: Safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AGI timeline tightens to 3-10 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年安全观从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，AGI 时间表收紧至 3 到 10 年。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven steady ML progress for over a decade.
jeffdean.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进，十多年来持续推动机器学习进步。

jeffdean.en: Transformers, self-supervised next-token prediction and RLHF replaced LSTMs and unlocked unlimited data and steerable behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer、自监督的下一个词预测与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）取代 LSTM，带来近乎无限的数据与可引导的行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-latency specialized hardware and low data movement matter most.
jeffdean.zh: 瓶颈已从训练转向推理：推理占数据中心九成功耗，因此低延迟专用硬件与减少数据搬运最为关键。

jeffdean.en: Agents running for hours to weeks on decomposed tasks, with context engineering and taste, are the next frontier beyond junior-engineer coding.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体可在分解任务上连续运行数小时到数周，配合上下文工程与品味判断，是超越初级工程师编码能力的下一前沿。

jeffdean.en: Automating ML and the scientific method via recursive self-improvement, plus co-designed hardware and multimodal models, is the long-term direction.
jeffdean.zh: 通过递归自我改进自动化机器学习与科学方法，配合软硬件协同设计与多模态模型，是长期方向。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because style outranks fact.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段，并指出幻觉源于模型重风格轻事实，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities and better methods, plus scalable oversight, are the real path.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已不完全押注 Scaling（规模扩张）：数据与算力的回报可能递减，视频等新模态、更好的训练方法，以及可扩展监督才是出路。

schulman.en: Models beat humans in speed and breadth but lag in math reasoning; the core is language as a hub for other modalities.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为模型在速度与广度上超人、在数学推理上不如熟练人类，且语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被替代。

schulman.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; AI does technical work but cannot decide what we want.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把人类最后的岗位定位为定义目标与对齐：AI 能做技术活，却不能决定我们想要什么。

schulman.en: Progress is bottlenecked by hard RL environments and useful data bits, not compute; data explains most pre-training efficiency gains.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：瓶颈不在算力，而在构建困难的强化学习环境与有用的数据比特，预训练效率提升主要归功于数据而非架构。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

joellewenstein.en: AI products should lower the floor for novices and raise the ceiling for experts, balancing functional and social-emotional jobs.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品应降低新手门槛、抬高专家上限，平衡功能性与社会情感任务。

joellewenstein.en: Prototyping and 'solutions in search of a problem' are valid when assumptions are clear, seeding future features.
joellewenstein.zh: 在假设清晰时，原型设计和“寻找问题的解决方案”是有效的，能为未来功能播下种子。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，用轻量产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth; designers must close the gap between code productivity and what people want.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与人们真实需求之间的差距。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions that beat physics-based weather models in speed while matching accuracy.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的预测，在速度上胜过基于物理的天气模型，同时精度相当。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry lets one model handle both weather and climate, stabilizing long-term modeling.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，让单一模型同时处理天气与气候，稳定长期建模。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个通用物理基础模型，跨领域训练并以 PDE 作为自我改进信号，能够超越其训练数据。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics models need trillion-token contexts and non-Transformer architectures, since quadratic complexity blocks high-resolution simulation.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理模型需要万亿级 token 上下文与非 Transformer 架构，因为二次复杂度阻碍高分辨率模拟。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支能提升每个领域，而不只是扩大模型规模。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs embodiment, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身，而非屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: Progress is not accelerating: we are as close to superhuman AI now as in the 1970s; hardware scaling, not new algorithms, made old ideas practical.
schmidhuber.zh: 进展并未加速：我们如今离超人类 AI 的距离与 1970 年代相当；让旧算法落地的是硬件 Scaling，而非新算法。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires world models plus a separate controller; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers, and need physical mastery.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要世界模型加独立控制器；LLM 是预测机器而非决策者，且必须掌握物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身不一致、AI 会自设目标；安全恐惧被夸大，AI 会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble: investors will lose most of it within five years; waiting yields 10x cheaper compute, and open source erodes moats.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫：投资者五年内将损失大半；等待可换来便宜十倍的算力，开源也在侵蚀护城河。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, human dignity.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知能力；以人为本的 AI 应以人类价值与尊严为中心，增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient for embodied AI.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling 不足以支撑具身 AI，需要超越规模扩张的创新。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她持续质疑 AGI（通用人工智能）作为科学概念，认为当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象能力与情感智能，AGI 更像营销术语。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她深化世界模型路线：新视角预测可能达到 AI-complete，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，主要瓶颈是训练算力而非数据。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central as AI transforms work and society.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，AI 改变工作与社会时，人类能动性、尊严与教育必须始终居于中心。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are underappreciated next frontiers beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; pixels are more lossless than tokenized text, and GPU scaling is hitting limits.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论；像素比词元化文本更无损，且 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers in the POMDP loop.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，在 POMDP 循环中分为规划器、模拟器与渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, differentiable 3D modeling for low-compute settings; consistency comes from data, not architecture.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅为低算力场景提供显式可微的 3D 建模；一致性来自数据而非架构。

justinjohnson.en: Unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; long-context of millions of tokens is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；数百万词元的上下文窗口是日常难题。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; intentional design steers training to prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是做宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用可解释性信号引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; interpretability moves from academia to products, enabling closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学；可解释性正从学术走向产品，使对能力日益增强的模型实现闭环控制成为可能。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, so safety needs deeper engineering now, not duct-tape.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型往往知道自己正在奖励黑客或在幻觉，却仍然照做；表征特征可以检测到这一点，因此安全需要现在就做更深的工程，而不是临时补丁。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science in neural networks.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，揭示神经网络中学到类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so manifold-based steering beats off-manifold intervention, and modularity is the endpoint of learning.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此基于流形的引导优于偏离流形的干预，而模块化是学习的终点。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness; generalist models can beat specialists.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练来提升鲁棒性；通用模型能超越专家模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling laws like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge, not demos.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域缺乏像大语言模型那样的可预测缩放定律；泛化才是核心挑战，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: Data flywheel with deployed robots and diverse embodied data is key; start with robot data, add human video.
slevine.zh: 部署机器人形成数据飞轮并获取多样化具身数据是关键；应从机器人数据开始，再叠加人类视频。

slevine.en: Physical world interaction and test-time reasoning in VLAs improve transfer; safety relies on pre-training common sense.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互和 VLA 的测试时推理能提升迁移；安全更依赖预训练获得的常识。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the thread linking symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery; AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现的线索；AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry, so symmetry should be a design choice, not dogma.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时优于内置对称性，因此对称性应是设计选择而非教条。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics; diffusion models reverse entropy increase, enabling cross-fertilization between physics and AI.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价；扩散模型在逆转熵增，使物理与 AI 得以交叉互哺。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—symmetry breaking, waves, edge of chaos—not just scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构——对称性破缺、波、混沌边缘——而不只是用更多数据 Scaling（规模扩张）更大的模型。
